claim: Audit Trails exports decision logs as CSV and JSON.
Audit Trails keeps approved claims, sources, reviewer actions, and publication status visible before publication.
Audit Trails does not publish on its own and is not a substitute for legal approval.
approved_terms: does not publish;not a legal engine;legal approval

claim: A beta group reduced review handoff time by 31% across 14 launch reviews when claims, sources, and owner notes sat next to the draft.
Role-scoped approvals can assign reviewer groups by launch type, region, or content surface.
The diff view compares each draft paragraph with approved source notes and flags claim drift before publication.
Policy checks, assigned reviewer, and open claim can appear in the same review path before publication.
